From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Noventis SOC2 Q&A — quick calendar check

Thanks for the sync earlier — quick notes and decisions from today’s call (recording saved in shared folder).

Meeting summary (2026-09-08 14:00 PT):
- Attendees: Emily Park (Noventis), Marcus Li (Noventis), Ben Carter (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood CS), Soojin Lee (Redwood Security)
- Scope clarified: Noventis will evaluate Redwood for processing PHI-derived telemetry in US-only regions; no EU residency in scope for this phase.
- Key controls discussed:
  - Key management: Redwood supports KMS integration (customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or external HSM). Noventis asked for KMS rotation cadence and exported key lifecycle notes.
  - Logging/retention: We described our token-level access logs and the default 90-day retention; discussed options for retention extensions and redaction.
  - Network architecture: Marcus asked about VPC peering and private endpoints; we confirmed Private deployment option supports VPC-hosted routing and can provide a topology diagram.

Action items agreed:
1) Redwood to share a controls matrix mapping (SOC 2 / SIG) highlighting controls we can provide evidence for and expected artifacts (Ben) — due 2026-09-10 EOD.
2) Redwood Security to hand over a sanitized log sample and an anonymized architecture diagram for review (Soojim -> Soojin?) — due 2026-09-11.
3) Noventis to provide a prioritized list of controls they need evidence for first (Emily) — target 2026-09-14.

Notes on sensitive requests: Emily asked for details on our KMS integration docs. Soojin said we will not share private key material; we will provide integration steps, KMS policy examples, and rotation schedule.

Quoted from the call transcript (paraphrased):
> Emily: "We need concrete examples of what evidence looks like — logs, policy text, and a sample controls matrix."
> Soojin: "We can deliver an anonymized logs extract and a controls matrix that maps Redwood controls to SOC 2 criteria and the SIG question numbers."

Next steps: Ben will drop the controls matrix and a short artifact checklist to this thread; Soojin will upload the artifacts to the shared Drive link and ping you when available. Marissa will follow up on onboarding checklist and trial activation steps.

Best,
Ben

Attachment: call-recording-link (posted to Drive)
